title: [review] project-LICHEN-6mij.2.4: coap_oscore_auth_mutating returns stack pointer in plain buffer via result->payload
description: In coap_oscore.c:249, a stack-local uint8_t plain[CONFIG_LICHEN_OSCORE_PLAINTEXT_MAX] is declared. At line 283, result->payload is set to this stack buffer, which goes out of scope when coap_oscore_auth_mutating returns. The callers in coap_dtn.c and coap_server.c then use auth.payload (a dangling stack pointer) after the function returns. This is use-after-return UB. The buffer must be static, caller-owned, or heap-allocated. For example, the response ciphertext at line 26 uses a static buffer. Same pattern needed here.
